units.source_text: 来店铺的客人们虽很欣赏枫树的奇姿雄态，却很少有人注意树上还开着紫花地丁。

en.t: Although the customers who came to the shop greatly admired the maple tree's strange and majestic form, very few noticed that violets were also blooming on it.

units.source_text: 那长着老树瘤子的粗干，直到高处都长满了青苔，更增添了它的威武和雅致。

en.t: The thick trunk, gnarled with old knots, was covered in green moss even high up, which added still more to its grandeur and elegance.

units.source_text: 而寄生在上面的小小的紫花地丁，自然就不显眼了。

en.t: And so the tiny violets growing on it naturally became inconspicuous.
